tagline.zh: 手势释放的那一刻,把位置和速度一起移交给弹簧:直接操纵段(无缓动)+ 弹簧段(半隐式欧拉积分)拼成一条连续曲线;velocity 不交接,动画就「归零重启」——这是跟手感与玩具感的分水岭。
tagline.en: At the instant of release, hand both position and velocity to a spring: the direct-manipulation segment (no easing) and the spring segment (semi-implicit Euler) splice into one continuous curve; without the velocity handoff the animation restarts from rest — the line between feels-in-hand and feels-like-a-toy.

origin.zh: Motion 官方对物理弹簧的核心承诺:「物理弹簧会把既有手势/动画的速度纳入反馈」,velocity 参数缺省即「当前值速度」;对照反例:duration-based spring「从静止开始并忽略速度」(调研 10§7.3);Apple 同源:SwiftUI 文档写明「连续 spring 动画接力时保留速度」(调研 04§1.3);手写积分与速度接力代码范式出自卡槽弹簧的 springSlot——速度存 dataset、可中断续跑(调研 10§2.2)。生产实例:vaul 底部抽屉用释放速度阈值 0.4 + 进度 0.25 判定手势去向(调研 10§5.1)。
origin.en: Motion's core promise for physics springs: "physics-based spring animations incorporate the velocity of any existing gestures or animations", with velocity defaulting to "the current value's velocity"; the counterexample: duration-based springs "start from rest and ignore velocity" (research 10 §7.3); Apple concurs: SwiftUI docs state that successive spring animations "preserve velocity" across handoffs (research 04 §1.3); the hand-written integrator with velocity relay comes from the slot-spring recipe springSlot — velocity stored on the dataset, interruptible and resumable (research 10 §2.2). A production instance: the vaul bottom sheet routes the gesture by release-velocity threshold 0.4 plus progress 0.25 (research 10 §5.1).

effect.zh: 弹簧刚度 k(JS 型,demo 订阅后作用于半隐式欧拉积分 a = (−k·x − c·v)/m)。默认 300 取调研 10§2.2 springSlot 代码默认(300/25「中·微弹」档,10§2.3 实算 ζ≈0.722、过冲≈3.8%);k 提高 ω₀=√(k/m) 上升,启动更猛、到位更快(调研 10§6.3)。
effect.en: Spring stiffness k (JS-type, subscribed by the demo into the semi-implicit Euler step a = (−k·x − c·v)/m). Default 300 is the springSlot code default in research 10 §2.2 (the 300/25 "medium, slight bounce" tier — 10 §2.3 computes ζ≈0.722, overshoot≈3.8%); raising k raises ω₀=√(k/m): harder start, faster arrival (research 10 §6.3).

effect.zh: 阻尼系数 c(JS 型)。默认 25 同出调研 10§2.2;ζ = c/(2√(k·m)) 是手感第一变量——「抖几下」由 ζ 定,「抖多快」由 ω₀ 定(调研 10§4.3/§6.2);demo 实时换算 ζ 与预计过冲百分比。
effect.en: Damping coefficient c (JS-type). Default 25 also from research 10 §2.2; ζ = c/(2√(k·m)) is the first variable of feel — "how many wobbles" is ζ's job, "how fast they happen" is ω₀'s (research 10 §4.3/§6.2); the demo converts ζ and the predicted overshoot percentage live.

effect.zh: JS 型参数:释放瞬间是否把量测到的手势速度注入弹簧。on=速度随位置一起交接(Motion/SwiftUI 官方语义,调研 10§7.3/04§1.3);off=速度清零再启动——即 duration-based spring「从静止开始并忽略速度」的反例,快甩后回程明显「没劲」,对照即可体感速度接力的价值。
effect.en: JS-type param: whether the measured gesture velocity is injected into the spring at release. on = velocity hands over together with position (Motion/SwiftUI semantics, research 10 §7.3/04 §1.3); off = velocity zeroes before starting — the duration-based spring anti-pattern of "starting from rest and ignoring velocity": after a hard flick the return visibly lacks drive, the contrast makes the handoff's value felt.

note.zh: 实现只依赖 Pointer 事件(Baseline 2020-07,调研 04§5.1)、rAF 与 getBoundingClientRect,全浏览器可用;速度接力是纯 JS 积分,无 API 门槛;库内等价物(Motion 的 velocity 缺省注入、SwiftUI 弹簧接力保速)与平台无关。
note.en: The implementation needs only Pointer Events (Baseline 2020-07, research 04 §5.1), rAF and getBoundingClientRect — available everywhere; the velocity relay is pure JS integration with no API floor; the library equivalents (Motion's default velocity injection, SwiftUI springs preserving velocity across handoffs) are platform-independent.

fallback.zh: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 时跟手段保留(直接操纵不属于可省略动效),释放段直出:位置直接落回目标、不再积分滑行(与 inertia-gesture 条目同一降级口径);键盘提供固定速度甩动的等效路径,触屏走同一 Pointer 事件流。
fallback.en: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the drag segment is kept (direct manipulation is not an omissible effect) and release lands directly — position jumps to the target with no integration (the same degradation convention as the inertia-gesture entry); the keyboard offers a fixed-velocity flick equivalent, and touch rides the same Pointer event stream.

use.zh: 抽屉/底板/侧栏的拖拽释放——vaul 范式:速度阈值决定「放走还是拉回」(调研 10§5.1)
use.en: Drawer/sheet/sidebar drag release — the vaul paradigm: a velocity threshold decides release vs pull-back (research 10 §5.1)

use.zh: 拖拽排序/看板卡片的落位——松手瞬间卡片带速度滑进槽位(slot-spring 的 layoutId 气泡同理)
use.en: Drag-to-reorder / kanban card drops — the card glides into its slot carrying release velocity (same as slot-spring's layoutId bubble)

use.zh: 可中断的任何弹簧:中断/重触发时从「当前值 + 当前速度」续跑,永不归零重启(调研 10§7.3)
use.en: Any interruptible spring: interruption/re-trigger resumes from "current value + current velocity", never restarting from rest (research 10 §7.3)

avoid.zh: 拖拽中叠加缓动曲线——跟手段必须是 1:1 直接操纵,缓动会让指针与元素「脱钩」
avoid.en: Easing during the drag — the tracking segment must be 1:1 direct manipulation; easing decouples pointer from element

avoid.zh: 释放后用固定时长缓动(cubic-bezier/duration)接管——它无法吸收释放速度,快甩慢甩一个样(duration-based 反例,调研 10§7.3)
avoid.en: Taking over with a fixed-duration tween (cubic-bezier/duration) — it cannot absorb release velocity; hard flicks and soft drags look identical (the duration-based anti-pattern, research 10 §7.3)

avoid.zh: 把释放速度原样灌进低阻尼弹簧(ζ<0.4)——速度×低阻尼=失控过冲,先算 ζ 再接速度(调研 10§2.3 巧思 3)
avoid.en: Injecting raw release velocity into an under-damped spring (ζ<0.4) — velocity × low damping = runaway overshoot; compute ζ before the handoff (research 10 §2.3 craft 3)

a11y.zh: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 时跟手保留、释放直出落点(不做积分滑行);拖拽轨道可键盘操作(Enter 触发固定速度甩动),焦点描边清晰;速度读数与 ζ/过冲换算对视觉用户展示,而运动本身不承载任何关键信息——落位结果由最终位置与文本状态确认;触屏与鼠标走同一 Pointer 流,pointercancel(系统手势接管)按释放处理。
a11y.en: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, tracking is kept and release lands directly (no integration glide); the drag lane is keyboard-operable (Enter triggers a fixed-velocity flick) with a clear focus ring; velocity readouts and ζ/overshoot conversions serve sighted users while motion itself carries no critical information — the outcome is confirmed by final position and text state; touch and mouse share one Pointer stream, and pointercancel (system gesture takeover) is treated as a release.

goal.zh: 复刻一次曲线接力:拖拽段 1:1 直写 transform 跟手;释放瞬间量测手势速度,连同位置一起交给半隐式欧拉弹簧(k/c 取快照,速度可开关)滑回目标;读数显示释放速度、ζ 与预计过冲;提供归零重启的反例对照。
goal.en: Replicate a curve handoff: the drag segment writes transform 1:1 to track the pointer; at release the measured gesture velocity is handed to a semi-implicit Euler spring (k/c from the snapshot, velocity switchable) gliding back to target; readouts show release velocity, ζ and predicted overshoot; include the restart-from-rest anti-pattern for contrast.

acceptance.zh: 跟手段零缓动:pointermove 直写 transform,单步积分器 dt 钳制(≤1/30s)防跳帧
acceptance.en: Zero easing while tracking: pointermove writes transform directly, with the integrator's dt clamped (≤1/30s) against frame jumps

acceptance.zh: 释放时量测速度(指针采样平滑),handoff=on 时注入弹簧初速,off 时清零重启供对照
acceptance.en: Release measures velocity (smoothed pointer samples); handoff=on injects it as spring initial velocity, off zeroes it for contrast

acceptance.zh: 弹簧用半隐式欧拉积分(v += a·dt; x += v·dt),rest 走双阈值停机,demo 阈值标注为演示值
acceptance.en: The spring integrates semi-implicit Euler (v += a·dt; x += v·dt) and rests on a dual threshold, with the demo's thresholds labeled as demo values

acceptance.zh: 读数:释放速度 px/s、ζ = c/(2√(k·m)) 与预计过冲 e^(−πζ/√(1−ζ²))(ζ≥1 时显示 0/过阻尼)
acceptance.en: Readouts: release velocity px/s, ζ = c/(2√(k·m)) and predicted overshoot e^(−πζ/√(1−ζ²)) (ζ≥1 shows 0/over-damped)

acceptance.zh: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 时跟手保留、释放直出落点;轨道可键盘触发固定速度甩动
acceptance.en: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, tracking is kept and release lands directly; the lane supports keyboard-triggered fixed-velocity flicks
